servinfo.title: Emergency Lever of Rearend Door Description (If Equipped)
servinfo.ptxt: Emergency lever (1) is provided in rearend door lock assembly (2). If rearend door cannot be unlocked due to complete discharge of the battery or a problem of the door lock system, operating the lever in the following method allows the rearend door to be unlocked:

item.ptxt: Remove cap (3) in arrow direction “1” and operate emergency lever in arrow direction “2”.
